source_title: 와뉴비 다들 왜 사제 안키우는 지 알거같다
subtitle: 수도원 주특입 8바퀴의 기적

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
드디어 수도원 레벨!
화이트메인 템 졸업하게
주특입 파티 모았다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle three-quarter shot of a Night Elf Priestess standing proudly on the left against a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background, with her golden cleric staff strapped neatly across her back. She holds up a rolled fantasy parchment flyer in both hands with sparkling, determined eyes and a bright confident smile, with minimal floor shadow beneath her feet.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
모자에 주문력·정신력?
고술인 저도 다 쓰는 옵이니
주특 입찰 감사히 먹겠습니다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic slightly high-angle two-shot against a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the right foreground, a cheerful Troll Shamaness with her dual axes strapped on her back hugs a red-and-gold feathered pointed cloth hat tightly to her chest with a cheeky grin. On the mid-left, the Night Elf Priestess with her staff on her back leans forward with wide shocked eyes and empty outstretched hands in disbelief.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 마법 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 최대 18만큼 증가합니다.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
어, 이게 힐러 무기였어요?
이미 착귀라 못 돌려드림!
파티 수고요~
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind the stunned Night Elf Priestess in the left foreground against a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. In the right mid-ground, an Orc Warrior with her shield and weapon strapped on her back sprints away while glancing back with a sheepish grin, holding a small, slender one-handed wooden-and-gold scepter in one hand and waving goodbye with the other.

Front-facing medium shot of the Night Elf Priestess slumped defeatedly on the floor at center against a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background, her golden cleric staff lying flat beside her. She hugs her knees with hollow, soulless wide eyes and dramatic dark vertical gloom lines shadowing her face, next to a tiny empty wooden loot chest.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
주문력 붙어서 보기 비스긴
한데… 너무 간절해 보이시네요.
전 패스할게요, 드세요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter side-profile two-shot against a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, a tired, cool-headed Undead Paladin in plate armor holds her golden paladin shield on her left arm with her mace sheathed at her hip, calmly extending the small slender one-handed wooden-and-gold scepter with her right hand. On the right, the slumped Night Elf Priestess looks up with trembling, watery eyes.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
고맙다 보기야…!!
8바퀴 만에 무기 먹었다!
넌 진짜 착한 기사야아아!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle two-shot against a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Night Elf Priestess with her cleric staff on her back kneels sobbing comical waterfalls of joyful tears while hugging the small slender one-handed scepter tightly with both hands. On the right, the Undead Paladin with her golden shield on her back awkwardly looks away, scratching her cheek with one free hand.
